ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) with localized high-intensity (white) regions. Approximate pixel ratio of 1:7 high-intensity to low-intensity across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white wedge-shaped region on the inner right lobe extending from the notch towards the center; small isolated high-intensity pixel clusters at the distal right tip; left lobe is a near-uniform low-intensity field with negligible mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations detected along the entire trailing edge, with the greatest peak-to-valley pixel variance occurring at the distal right extremity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave sweep from the notch transitioning to a steep convex curve towards the terminal points; right lobe tip shows a more vertical terminal sweep than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct high-contrast white circular ring formations (approximately 10-15 pixels in diameter) located on the upper-most edge of the distal right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple diagonal light-gray linear pixel disruptions on the inner right lobe surface, oriented toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged loss of trailing edge continuity at the distal right tip; presence of circular high-contrast lesions/scars at the right lobe terminal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique paired-ring high-contrast formation on the extreme lateral edge of the right lobe, appearing as two adjacent white circles.
